sources.quote: Compare Polish wesele, Belarusian вяселле (vjasjellje), Slovak veselie, all meaning "wedding party", Romanian veselie (“joy”). By surface analysis, веселий (veselyj, “happy, merry”) + -я (-ja). Ultimately from Proto-Slavic *veselьje either directly or via Polish.
